- SAML: do you support group assertions in the SAML response? If so, what attribute name do you expect?

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually). Thank you for the list — I've attached a preflight checklist that we use for enterprise SSO/SCIM rollouts. High level plan (proposed):

1) Preflight (this week) — network prep, IdP metadata, SCIM mapping spreadsheet, test account list.
2) STAGE tests (2–3 business days) — SCIM provisioning for a small group, SAML test login, audit log verification.
3) Canary cutover (2–4 hours window) — switch 10 pilot users, monitor logs/latency/SCIM diffs.
4) Full cutover (off-hours) — schedule 02:00–04:00 PST preferred; rollback plan ready.

Notes/answers:
- SAML group attribute: we accept groups in the standard "groups" attribute (string[]). If your IdP uses eduPersonEntitlement or a custom attribute, we can map it but please send metadata.
- SCIM mapping: we recommend mapping Okta Group -> Redwood role (example in attachment). Please include one column for "redwood_role" and one for "group_filter".
- IP allowlist: we'll provide a temporary set of egress IPs for the canary and a finalized CIDR block for production once PO is signed. For planning, include 3 /24s: 34.142.10.0/24, 34.142.11.0/24, 34.142.12.0/24 (subject to change).
- Service accounts: we advise two accounts — a "scim-provisioner" with narrow SCIM write scope and an "api-runtime" with restricted model inference access. Token rotation: Redwood supports automated rotation via our KMS integration; long-lived tokens are discouraged.

Attachments: ther a_preflight_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet) — please populate the IdP metadata and test user list.

I'll loop Ben (implementation lead) for the SCIM/SAML specifics and Marissa for milestones and procurement coordination. Proposed kickoff: Monday 2026-12-20 10:00 AM PST — does that work?

Best,
Irene
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

--

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: TheraHealth onboarding — SCIM/SAML mapping + service account guidance

Alex / Irene — quick technical notes to help your IdP/infra team prepare:

SCIM (v2) recommendations:
- User attributes: userName (email), name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work].value.
- Group provisioning: we accept group membership changes via /Groups endpoint. Map Okta group displayName -> Redwood role. Sample mapping (see attached scim-sample-mapping.json):
  - Okta: "thera_admins" -> Redwood role: "admin"
  - Okta: "thera_readers" -> Redwood role: "viewer"

SAML attributes:
- Required: NameID (email), email, givenName, familyName.
- Optional for RBAC: groups (array) or an attribute like "urn:thera:role" if you prefer single-value role assertions.

Service accounts and scoping:
- Create two scoped service accounts as Irene suggested. Use short-lived keys where possible: recommended rotation = 30 days for provisioner tokens, 7 days for runtime tokens.
- If you must support legacy long-lived tokens, we can produce a scoped token with read-only SCIM access and strict IP restrictions; this requires an exception request and approval from security.

Network / Firewall:
- The temporary CIDRs Irene listed are for planning only. For STAGE/canary we'll provide a small set of NAT IPs; for PROD we'll provide final CIDRs once procurement is complete.

Please upload your IdP metadata XML (Okta metadata link) and a sample SCIM group export and I'll validate mappings before kickoff.

Attachments: scim-sample-mapping.json (example mapping)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference

--
